doc.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025

title: Friendly chat and Greg Caputo, Joe Wilder
summary: The two enjoy each other, talk of meeting in person and a shared connection to Greg Caputo and Joe Wilder.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Your demeanor is so wonderful, I could talk to you all day. You have the right —
I’d love to do it in person sometime.
Well the next time I’m up in that area I will find you.
How do you know Greg Caputo?
We connected through an Arts In Education program and we ended up doing some school concerts with a program that I worked with in Central New York, and we backed up Joe Wilder on a little tour.
“Gentleman of Jazz” I used to call him.
I’m telling you he is one of my favorite people in the whole world.
